frequency_question: How often do jurisdictions with a 0% CCyB raise it above 0% within a two-year window when credit-to-GDP gaps are moderate or rising?
membership_rule: Includes all post-2016 observations of Basel III adhering central banks maintaining an active CCyB framework.
provenance_note: claims 25 cases from only 6 named (4.2x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 25 observed country-cycles; captures major G-SIB regulators.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions with non-standard capital frameworks.
skeleton: Jurisdictions with active CCyB frameworks tracked across 4 distinct macro-financial cycles over 10 years across 15 major Basel Committee member nations.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 25 observed distinct tightening windows across the peer group.
validity_reason: Basel III macroprudential framework rules remain stable through the end of the decade.
